title: solanum nigrum var. legitimum
intro: Solanum nigrum var. legitimum, commonly known as garden black nightshade or true black nightshade, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to help in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Solanum nigrum var. legitimum include analgesic, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which contribute to its use in the management of pain, muscle spasms, and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of the plant include glycoalkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
